name: LT1363 / LT1364 / LT1365
tagline: Linear's 1994 70 MHz, 1000 V/µs C-Load dual: a cheap Japanese favourite, fast and transparent; English forums split.

lineage.note: Top of the LT1354–LT1365 C-Load family (LT1358/59 2 mA, LT1360–62 4 mA, LT1363–65 6.3 mA).
Re-hosts Linear Rev A files (13645fa, 1363fa); product pages for LT1363/4/5. No new datasheet revision.

part_numbers.note: Single, own datasheet 1363fa. LT1363CS8#TRPBF at DigiKey (505-LT1363CS8#TRPBFCT-ND); LT1363CN8#PBF at brokers.
8-lead PDIP, θJA 130 °C/W, C grade; the op-amp rollers' part. DigiKey 891887, Arrow, Akizuki.
8-lead SO, top mark '1364', θJA 190 °C/W. #PBF/#TRPBF listed as production by ADI.
Discontinued per ADI PDN 25_0027; #PBF versions replace them. LT1363 is single.

reputation.summary: Mixed, based on listening reports; no ASR or Samuel Groner measurements. Head-Fi users find it as quiet as OPA2134 with more transparency and less grain, and faster than OPA6x7. diyAudio suggests it for delta-sigma DAC filters, but critics call it coloured, able to 'kill nuances'. Japanese bloggers (Akizuki sells it) praise fast, uncoloured, 'tight, lean-muscled' sound.
typical_uses: Delta-sigma DAC I/V, filter and buffer stages
Op-amp rolling: DACs, headphone amps, Xonar/Prodigy, TubeMagic D1
caveats: Runs hot: 6.3 mA per amp; a DIP-8 dual at ±15 V dissipates ~0.38 W, ~50 °C rise.
70 MHz: layout-, socket- and decoupling-sensitive. Bypass 0.01–0.1 µF close; add CF when RF > 5 kΩ.
High bias current (up to 2 µA): ~200 mV offset with 100 kΩ. Balance impedances or AC-couple.
9 nV/√Hz is noisier than NE5532/LM4562: poor for phono or high-gain stages.
No comparator use or sustained differential input. C grade guaranteed only 0–70 °C; I/military grades by consultation.

counterfeit_notes: No LT136x-specific fakes reported; the 'white print' tip concerns other op-amps. Checks: SO-8 marked '1364'; ~12.6 mA per dual at ±15 V; ~1000 V/µs at AV = −2. Ink and laser marks are both genuine (PCN 21_0060).

silicon_changes.identification: Older parts have an ink top mark, newer parts a laser mark (8-SOICN). Text still reads '1363' or '1364'.
silicon_changes.summary: Marking only: legacy Linear 8-SOICN top mark changed from ink to laser. Both styles are genuine; no die change.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - marking change only; same die and package.
silicon_changes.verification: Rev B summary lists LT1363CS8#TRPBF and LT1364CS8; ink-to-laser detail from LT1361-family records. PDF not read.

part_numbers_affected: LT1364 (variants not itemised; per PCN 22_0241 affected-parts summary)
silicon_changes.identification: By date code only: parts coded 2242 (2022 week 42) or later use the new epoxy; rollout due complete by DC2317. No visible difference.
silicon_changes.summary: Die-attach epoxy changed from Henkel 8290 to 8290A (Loctite Ablestik). ADI states no impact to fit, form or function, with improved reliability. Die and wafer process unchanged. PCN Rev - and Rev A exist.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected: assembly material only, no electrical specification change.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - qualified assembly material change; same die.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN text confirms the epoxy change and DC2242–DC2317 rollout; LT1364 listing not seen in excerpts.

silicon_changes.identification: Older parts carry the trace code on the package bottom; newer parts in the top-side laser mark. Identified by date code.
silicon_changes.summary: Marking only: bottom-side trace code moved into the top-side laser mark, standardising ADI marking. No form, fit, function or reliability impact. PCN 24_0234 covers PDIP (effective 2025-01-10); 24_0236 is its companion for other packages.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN 24_0234 appendix lists LT1364CN8#PBF; LT1364 in 24_0236 not itemised.

silicon_changes.identification: Leaded (non-#PBF) SO-8 codes only; LT1364CS8#PBF and LT1363CS8#PBF/#TRPBF are the named replacements.
silicon_changes.summary: Discontinuance of leaded SO-8 ordering codes; lead-free versions of the same parts continue. LT1365 not listed.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - same part in lead-free finish.
silicon_changes.verification: PDN appendix lists codes and replacements; notice date not seen.

Locate the 1994 originals (13645f, 1363f) in early mirrors; did Rev A change any limits? When was 1363fa printed?

claims_confirmed: ADI hosts 13645fa.pdf with footer '13645fa LT/TP 0400 2K REV A' (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/13645fa.pdf).
DigiKey hosts an HTML LT1364/LT1365 datasheet (https://www.digikey.com/en/htmldatasheets/production/80198/0/0/1/lt1364-lt1365-datasheet.html).
LT1364CN8#PBF is listed at DigiKey and Arrow (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/analog-devices-inc/LT1364CN8-PBF/891887).
70 MHz, 1000 V/µs; drives 150 Ω to ±7.5 V (±15 V) and ±3.4 V (±5 V); stable with any capacitive load (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/13645fa.pdf).
Head-Fi: as quiet as OPA2134 with more transparency, less grain; OPA6x7 loses pace and rhythm (https://www.head-fi.org/threads/the-opamp-thread.432749/page-75).
diyAudio: suits delta-sigma DAC filters and low-impedance headphones (https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/the-best-sounding-audio-integrated-opamps.154106/page-41).
No LT1364-specific counterfeit or die-change information found (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/698032/LINER/LT1364.html).
PCN 24_0234 (PDIP trace code to top side, effective 2025-01-10) lists LT1364CN8#PBF (https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/4419216.pdf).
PCN 22_0241: Henkel 8290 to 8290A, from DC2242, complete by DC2317; no fit, form or function impact (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_22_0241_Rev_A_Form.pdf).
PDN 25_0027 discontinues LT1364CS8, LT1363CS8, LT1363CS8#TR; #PBF codes replace them (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/7121/ADI_PDN_25_0027_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
ADI product page lists LT1364CS8#PBF and #TRPBF in production (https://www.analog.com/zh/products/lt1364).
refuted_claims: 'No die change after ADI took over Linear' has no traceable source; not recorded as a silicon change.
'Genuine Linear parts have distinctive white print' is not LT1364-specific; it comes from a 2019 post about other op-amps.
Rev A is not 'dated 1994': 1994 is the copyright year; the print code LT/TP 0400 means April 2000.
Earlier PCN watch item resolved: PCN 21_0060, PCN 22_0241, PCN 24_0234 and PCN 24_0236 are marking or assembly changes, none a die or wafer change.

Unconfirmed fab move: Hillview closure (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000006281/000119312518024527/d525969d8k.htm) not tied to LT136x; PCN 19_0067 (BCD to Vanguard) and PCN 25_0091 (Camas bipolar) name other parts.
